# Scope list: Larkspur Ridge Water District, Operations Building Addition and Yard Improvements, Permit Set 2026-07-30

41 candidates recorded: 35 included, 2 for review, 4 excluded. Sheets: 19 of 20 reviewed (0 via OCR, 1 unreadable, 0 not reviewed).

Drawing-backed scope only. No quantities or pricing. Each item cites the sheet and the place on the sheet it came from. This is a draft for review against the full contract documents, not a takeoff or an estimate.

## Assumptions

- The existing 12 in ductile iron water main across the site is protected in place and potholed for depth before excavation; no relocation is shown or carried. (Source: C-101, keyed site note 3) [cand-005]
- Sound attenuation batts named in partition type P1 are carried inside the Division 09 partition assembly rather than separately in Division 07. (Source: A-102, keyed plan note 1) [cand-018]

## Exclusions (by others)

- Existing operations building finishes are not in contract. (Source: A-501, finish note 1)
- Special inspections per IBC Chapter 17 are arranged and paid for by the owner. (Source: S-001, design criteria)

  Source: M-101, Mechanical note 2: "THERMOSTATS AND DDC POINTS ARE FURNISHED, INSTALLED, AND PROGRAMMED BY THE DISTRICT'S CONTROLS VENDOR UNDER A SEPARATE CONTRACT."
  Reason: Mechanical note 2 assigns the thermostats and DDC points to the District's controls vendor under a separate contract, so this is not contractor scope. Carried in Division 25 integrated automation rather than Division 23 because the work is controls, not HVAC equipment.

## RFIs / review items

### RFIs

- A-601 is a scanned raster sheet and OCR recovered fewer than twenty words. Request a native PDF of the door and window schedule so door marks, frame types, glazing, and hardware sets can be read. (Source: A-601) [cand-020]
- C-201 keyed utility note 4 points to E-101 for the electrical service conduit and pull vault, but E-101 shows no service conduit, vault, transformer pad, one-line diagram, or panel schedule. Confirm who installs the service conduit and vault and issue the sheet that shows it. (Source: C-201, keyed utility note 4; E-101 extracted text) [cand-009]
- No wall finish is scheduled for the gypsum board surfaces outside the Wash Bay 101 FRP wainscot. The A-501 finish schedule carries floor and ceiling codes only and no paint code appears anywhere in the set. Confirm the wall finish. (Source: A-501, finish schedule)

### Review items

Drawing-backed but unresolved. Each stays off the included list until the question in its reason is answered.

#### Division 08: Openings

- **Personnel doors, frames, hardware, and windows** (reference_only) [cand-020]
  Source: A-102, also A-601, Keyed plan note 3: "PERSONNEL DOORS, FRAMES, HARDWARE, AND WINDOWS PER THE SCHEDULE ON SHEET A-601."
  Reason: A-102 points to the schedule on A-601 and does not show the doors, frames, hardware sets, or windows itself. A-601 is a scanned sheet and OCR recovered fewer than twenty words, so no door mark, frame type, or hardware set is confirmed. Stays under review until a native A-601 arrives.

#### Division 26: Electrical

- **Electrical service conduit and pull vault** (reference_only) [cand-009]
  Source: C-201, also E-101, Keyed utility note 4: "ELECTRICAL SERVICE CONDUIT AND PULL VAULT, SEE E-101."
  Reason: C-201 keyed utility note 4 points to E-101 for the service conduit and pull vault and does not show either itself. The extracted text of E-101 has no service conduit, pull vault, transformer pad, one-line diagram, or panel schedule, so no sheet in the set shows the work. Cross-sheet reference only; stays off the included list until the service scope is confirmed. See the open RFI.
